hotspots.title: Outrage over Trump administration Yosemite land swap deal
hotspots.blurb: Media coverage is reacting sharply to reports that the Trump administration is considering swapping a parcel of Yosemite National Park land with a private developer to build a road. Critics and environmental advocates are raising legal and ethical concerns over handing public national park territory to private real estate interests.
hotspots.affect: Public land privatization drives intense moral outrage and environmental alarm across reporting outlets.

hotspots.title: Legal battles escalate over Trump executive orders on mail-in voting
hotspots.blurb: A series of federal court rulings have delivered major setbacks to the Trump administration's executive actions, highlighted by a judge temporarily blocking executive orders aimed at restricting mail-in voting. The ongoing court fights highlight growing judicial scrutiny over administration policies spanning voting rules, military bans, and tech restrictions.
hotspots.affect: High-stakes battles over voter access and executive overreach provoke intense polarized contention and legal alarm.

hotspots.title: President Trump signs order establishing U.S. Space Academy
hotspots.blurb: President Trump signed an executive order establishing a national Space Academy to train personnel for the Space Force, NASA, and the civilian space industry. The initiative was paired with high-profile space ceremonies honoring astronaut achievements, presented as a cornerstone of American technological and military dominance.
hotspots.affect: Coverage is driven by high-energy patriotic triumph and celebration of expanded military-space capabilities.

hotspots.title: Trump administration aggressive energy policy push sparks contention
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration's aggressive expansion of fossil fuels is sparking significant legal and political conflict. Accelerated environmental reviews for the Trans-Alaska Pipeline and major international oil deals contrast sharply with state lawsuits over cancelled offshore wind leases in California.
hotspots.affect: Clashes over environmental deregulation versus fossil fuel expansion fuel polarized energy debate and state-versus-federal conflict.
